decision: Separate existing KDE Chrome process qualification from presentation into kde/chrome.rs, keeping exact predicates,100ms budget, call order and all common authority/output contracts.
reason: kde/display/chrome.rs currently owns process eligibility instead of rendering. Isolate client qualification so styling changes cannot silently edit that policy; no new functional defect or transport is asserted.
verification: Preserve exact function bodies and one-to-one test namespace migration, all other test identities/classes. Required full source/release gates,10artifact build/installation proof, unchanged fullChrome220 and short Firefox controls.
not_tested: All implementation/source/native/CI/updater results are pending. Local GNOME remains untouched; no universal client acceptance.

alternatives.name: Move existing client policy with unchanged bodies

test_manifest_change: The owning preflight already allows exactly one namespace migration with unchanged body/category/negative conditions, no added/removed semantic tests and no known failures. The manifest and its SHA change together for that move; no failure is waived.
